complete_examples.text: This model employs a novel iterative algorithm to describe and compute the static deformation of the track induced by the AFZ.

The calculational results are in excellent agreement with the results calcu lated by ABAQUS in Tan’s work [14], indicating the iterative algorithm proposed in this paper can better deal with the deformation behavior of track subject to AFZ.
